title: Epsilon-Delta Proof for a Linear Function
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Prove using the epsilon-delta definition that lim_{x -> 3} (4x - 5) = 7.

steps.title: Analyze the Target Distance
steps.explanation: Evaluate the absolute difference between f(x) and the claimed limit L = 7.
steps.why: The goal is to bound |f(x) - L| in terms of |x - c|.

steps.title: Solve for the Input Tolerance Delta
steps.explanation: Set 4|x - 3| < epsilon to find the required bound on |x - 3|.
steps.why: Delta must ensure that whenever |x - 3| < delta, the target inequality holds.

steps.title: Write the Formal Verification
steps.explanation: State the formal implication demonstrating that the chosen delta satisfies the definition.
steps.why: A rigorous mathematical proof must proceed from hypothesis to conclusion.
